  `role` enum('admin','user') COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user',
  `is_active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',

  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `users_username_unique` (`username`),
  UNIQUE KEY `users_admin_slot_unique` (`admin_slot`),
  CONSTRAINT `users_active_check` CHECK ((`is_active` in (0,1)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=7 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_as_cs

CREATE TABLE `products` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `category_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `unit_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `code` varchar(60) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL,
  `active_ingredient` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs DEFAULT NULL,
  `sale_price` decimal(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  `tax_rate` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `expiry_warning_days` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `products_code_unique` (`code`),
  KEY `products_category_id_index` (`category_id`),
  KEY `products_unit_id_index` (`unit_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `products_category_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`category_id`) REFERENCES `product_categories` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `products_unit_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`unit_id`) REFERENCES `units` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `products_active_check` CHECK ((`is_active` in (0,1))),
  CONSTRAINT `products_expiry_check` CHECK (((`expiry_warning_days` is null) or (`expiry_warning_days` between 0 and 3650))),
  CONSTRAINT `products_price_check` CHECK ((`sale_price` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `products_tax_check` CHECK (((`tax_rate` is null) or (`tax_rate` between 0 and 100)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=6 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_as_cs
